versions.changelog: Ranking fix: ClawHub mirrors skills.sh entries (12 of 77 sampled results) and was crediting them clawhub's top authority purely for passing through. Attribution now reads install.kind. Ships separately from the 1.3.x relevance and crawl work.
Single VERSION constant as the source of truth; USER_AGENT derives from it. Fixes a recurring publish-order bug where the published artifact claimed two different versions.
Published test suite now passes from an installed copy: docs-consistency tests no longer assume skill-card.md, which clawhub publish does not ship. 145 tests.
Docs: correct the ranking formula and dedup rule in references/sources.md, both of which still described pre-1.3.0 behaviour. Syncs USER_AGENT with the published version.

Removes the importlib exec_module loader from the test suite, which static analysis flagged as dynamic_code_execution. It only loaded this package's own script; replaced with a plain sys.path import. No behaviour change.
